title: Moreish Puff Vanilla Shakes 100ml
description: Moreish Puff’s Vanilla sub ohm e-juice is a milky mixture of decadent ice cream, sweetened milk and fresh, fragrant vanilla pods blended together to create a smooth, creamy sensation which keeps you coming back for second helpings! This Moreish Puff e-liquid is available in a handy 100ml shortfill bottle and is ideal for adding a nicotine shot to achieve your desired strength. Simply add your nic shot directly into the 100ml bottle to mirror your current nicotine consumption and enjoy this mouth-watering, moreish masterpiece!
